reviews.text: I wanted to play when it was out, but I have to go to the dentist. I'll play it later. Amazing demo, i'm sure it will be great
好玩~ 肉鸽类的种菜游戏， 动画和音乐都很精致，而且难能可贵的是这全是作者一个人做的 有些进阶有些确实比较困难，不过糊了还是很爽的，嘎嘎收菜~ 试玩版就玩了好几十小时，推荐嗷嗷~

我不知道作者有没有玩过自己的游戏，正式版比起demo难了简直不是一星半点，锻造升级要的宝石太过逆天导致一层拿不到关键卡根本升级不了（无法低代价升级卡牌），而稻草人和植物凑数卡和垃圾卡又太多污染卡池，问号收益到离谱完全不如一直打怪且开局卡组过于弱且随机导致又要rosl（既视感拉满）开局，想过前期要不狗运好听key牌，不然只能拿一堆过度无法升级无法压缩卡组没成长慢慢被滚雪球，某种程度上也是限制大卡组（？） 通关倒是不难，但是全程没有爽感，内容也比较少，目前来说不推荐，先看后续更新吧

cleverly well-designed compact little game with high replayability, love it. not sure why but this game keeps reminding me of Plants vs. Zombies. maybe an idea for a future hazard? + there’s a tutorial, and NPCs explaining things from time to time + pets / scarecrows / trading card packs / biomes. + wide variety of cards and upgrade diversities. + detailed info on every card. + smooth & snappy UI + you can complete a level early. - can't undo a move? - no shortcut tips when hovering over the buttons. - where do i find the shortcut manual? i figured out X = end turn / H = harvest / WASD / 1234. - can't remap keys. - TAB gets registered when exiting the SHIFT+TAB.

Congrats on the game ! This is quite a joyful experience ! And not pricy at all. But.. unfortunately after almost 10 hours of playing cracks in the balance show off.. - in 10 hours i only managed to beat the game once (thus unlocking the dog from 7 pets) and i feel all my hard work was eclipsed by RNG and a huge amount of time kind of wasted.. - i understand unlocking the next pet taxes can be a bit higher with each but.. we have to HAVE at least more BONUSES with each pet otherwise the difficulty level makes the S2 and S3 not reachable. - the combos on the left must be nerfed so we can benefit from them at least from the middle of the game and not the LAST LEVEL.. Tried 3 times to beat S3 with the dog and failed on update 1.0.6 ! The game is almost there balance wise but now UI issues creep up: - you can't fast click after some event happens on the screen, you have to wait.. - the more than one slot cards stick very weird - i misclick so many times !

游戏还是不错的，但是有些人物的前期过渡太差劲，配合又恶心玩家。比如说鹅奶奶，这个设计为简单难度，我个人认为是这里面玩得最难受的人物。问题在于这个能量设计有许多稻草人可以配合，但是玩起来很难受。比如鹅奶奶+清晨补给+破烂王，可以实现矿泉水倒转。但是问题来了，这个combo，我的消耗矿泉水爆满，能量爆满。但是如果我要是用了矿泉水，下回合就会继续指数增加。并且消耗矿泉水是只能给地块的，不能空消耗。这样一来，我每回合都是手牌爆满矿泉水，其他手牌很难刷出来。又因为手牌爆满，我的游戏体验就很差。简言之，十分恶性，没有实现配合的爽感。
操作有点繁琐，拖得我手累，甚至连进入第二天的快捷键都没有，收货作物按钮又离得近，点错好几次很无语，玩了几轮都没有爽感
好玩但是很难，给的资源非常非常少，要好的工具，就不能有好的植物，想升级卡牌，就不能买卡牌，
无聊的游戏，没有任何爽感也就罢了，打一局还特别的折磨，第二层还没打完就一个小时了，杀戮尖塔一局也才一个小时，三层下来怕不是得两小时。你这局内的种田无聊得要死，这下明白种瓜得瓜为什么要设置个一键出牌了，毫无正反馈的游戏。 不过话虽如此，还是有一定的可玩性。 但是很多植物都不平衡，只有拿到强力植物才能赢。 真特么垃圾，尤其是那头驴，居然是最难的，难度标的不对，驴非常容易在开头暴毙。
需要局外成长，而不是单纯难度增长，好吗？只一味加难度就是差游戏，不局外成长那我玩一局退款得了呗？

The game wants to be fun. I'm still going to try a few more runs, but here's where I'm at: The game makes it so to unlock characters you have to beat the game with the character you just unlocked to get the next one. So if you're like me and are on the 3rd character; a meme cat that wasn't made to be cute, quirky, fun. Nope. Less cards in your hand. In a card game. How fun. HEY, GUYS, COME LOOK! I MADE A CHARACTER FOR THE GAME THAT REQUIRES ABSOLUTELY NO THOUGHT TO MAKE! IT DOESN'T GIVE PERKS TO ANY SPECIFIC STRATEGY, IT JUST FRUSTRATES THE PLAYER AND REMOVES ANY OF THE BALANCE IN THIS ALREADY CLUSTERED MESS OF RANDOMNESS! Couldn't of made the worthless character the last to be unlocked? Maybe just put them behind a currency from beating runs and let me just choose the one I want next? Are the other characters actually worse than the worthless, unoriginal meme cat? The core of the game is fun. Very nice. Refreshing. I do enjoy it. But at this moment in time over half of my play time is just doing the torture of trying to beat the game with the 3rd character. Just beat it. No additional OH MAN FLEX ON THE HOMIES AND SHOW THEM YOU BEAT AN ALREADY HARD GAME BY MAKING IT HARDER HURR DURR handicaps they make available after beating the game with them once. It would be nice to be able to make my own starter deck at some point instead of relying on the trash options at the start of every run, even drafting would be far, FAR superior. Just progress in general. Probably a skill issue. Probably just me. Just immensely frustrating. Another game that has 5 mechanics you need to focus on, but gives you no resources. You need to plow, plant, and water every turn. A lot of squares per card. Cards that effect multiple squares are made from upgrading. Upgrading requires a copy of the exact same card (once again, original. why not just a currency so I can upgrade the card I want instead of crossing my fingers?). To get these copies, you have to get lucky during a fight and pull the card during a mid-fight card selection, get lucky after the fight and get the card as a reward in a pack (which you only get one card from. that's right. You are rewarded with a pack of cards, but only keep one. ooo. aahh. how magnanimous.) These cards have to be the exact same as the ones you have to combine them, and you can pull a card that is at any stage in its evolution, because having just base level items in said packs as upgrade fodder would make sense and not waste more of my time. Why can't the forge break down cards? Why is that a function at the store? That makes no sense. Why can't I just go to the forge or store when I want? Is this not a farm? My farm? Why can't I just go into town and get what I need? Or have a delivery service and pay a little extra? Why can't I just throw cards I don't want into a mulch pile? It's as easy as just not putting the card into my deck. The game has great art, original mechanics, but heavily flavored with nonsense that was put into this game solely on the basis of "Well, other games in this genre have this, so this needs it, too." If you adore Dark Souls levels of pedantic gameplay that relies on razor sharp precise responses, but instead of rolling for twelve minutes in a circle around a set of legs, it's just you hoping that you can get a decent watering card, a mandatory plow card, and access to 2 or 3 maxed or near maxed level crop cards. And that's not including exhaust cards which are nice. And I didn't even mention scythes. It's an interesting mess that will probably frustrate you. Buyer beware.

乍一看是塔模式的游戏骨架，粗一玩又以为是小丑牌逻辑，但是实际上玩了才知道游戏有自己的一套设计逻辑。不过我有两个方面的看法，一点是游戏的画风卡通有趣，操作也很简化，但实际上循环逻辑很复杂，除了费用限制外，轮转需要开土、种子、浇水和收割，而且还涉及到顺序问题，因此循环起来很困难（也可能是我脑子不够用）；另一方面卡牌之间的平衡性差别大的离谱，明显地都不只是上下级了，甚至是费用、功能上的绝对碾压，而且有些需要局外才能解锁。我觉得这个问题出现在设计结构上，开土、浇水和收割同为循环的一环，但能体现功能差异化的仅在种子类型上，所以这些存在巨大数值差异化的卡牌获取与否就很大程度地影响了体验。综上，我觉得很有新意也很有趣，但是还需要更多的平衡。

It starts out good, but gets stale very quickly. The crops, jokers and random events don't offer very much in terms of flexible playstyles. It's pretty much the same for every run: you optimize your deck within a very narrow corridor. If you are looking for 20 hours of clickedy-click: buy. If you want more: don't.

I've hit the wall after only unlocking the cat. You can look over my video game history and know I'm a long time gamer. Here I am thinking, "Damn, this game is really quite challenging," then I consider I've played only two "easy" characters with none of their upper tiers unlocked. What am I missing about how to play this game? I'm ten hours in! I just can't recommend this game to players like me. No hand smoothing algorithm. How many times can I start a map with no way to affect the ground on turn one, even to plough? No way to concede when you know it's over. Colorful UI. Quirky animation. I don't know what's wrong with me or wrong with the game. It's me. You all know it's me.

有点类似于杀戮尖塔，但是不是攻防间的配合，而是作物和浇水的配合，基本上只要思路对了就能过，不卡数值，难度相对较为简单，无尽模式也没有太大压力，凑出无限卡组想玩多少关都随意，玩到无聊了自己退。是一款比较轻松休闲的小游戏，而且甚至鼓励去挑战，尖塔敢这样找架打早死翘翘了，而这边只会越战越强，只要别什么垃圾都往卡组塞就行了。顺带建议一下制作组，随着解锁卡牌的增多，应该设置一个局外增强用于禁用卡牌吧，后期卡池垃圾太多了

很好玩，试玩版玩的停不下来，就买了，没有后悔购买，有一定难度，可以自己构筑套路，适合喜欢玩卡牌类游戏又喜欢种田的玩家。我就是很难抗拒种田这件事，可能中国人的种田基因实在是天赋

脚填的数值，看似各种都有，整个牌库是完全不搭调的，套路是不够成熟的，最终的目的是找到传说整体转型，前期的付出是没有意义的，成功与不成功的差距巨大，慎入！ 更新补充下：真的别玩！你最终的成熟卡组根本没有意义，他每次的boss都会强行ban场地、ban天气、ban道具、ban基础卡组、甚至是ban你每回合的可使用的法力上限，所有的过程都是没有意义的，只会被强行卡死，最后死掉。 ！！过程是无聊的，充斥着所有的套路混杂全是垃圾搜半天；成型后没意义的，boss关会给你直接ban了。 ！！你玩吧，基础数值你也撸不过去，整套游戏下来是又臭又长，这种S.B游戏你就玩吧，人生就是太多时间了，来玩，玩完不如去看会儿西红柿小说，至少那个不花钱。

I've said it before and I'll say it again. Rougelite deckbuilders are a very saturated genre. It seems like every other day there is a new title and they usually recycle ideas from Slay the Spire, Balatro or Gordian Quest if devs are feeling fancy. Cropdeck is not one of those games. It's a deckbuilder trapped inside tetris kind of puzzle with a sprinkle of auto-battler mechanics on top. I know it sounds confusing but it is a lot of fun. Everything clicks here. From graphics, through sound design to gameplay. This is a true product of love and a work of art. If you like rougelite deckbuilders this is a must have. If you don't but enjoy puzzles - I'd still give it a go.
I have only played two runs but I had so much fun. The art is incredible and the gameplay just makes sense. Highly recommend!

评分：8/10（缺点多是因为我想吐槽，优点是入坑向的，可能在每个人眼里可能都不一样） 优点： 1、美术令人愉悦、种地主题天然加分； 2、玩法比较新颖，犁地、浇水和种地需要进行微妙的平衡； 3、游玩体验比较顺畅，卡组偏小不易卡手，构筑卡组的掌控感很强； 4、关卡具备一些丰富度（地形等）。 缺点： 1、缺少部分引导，比如每次施肥会把时间拉到5天，但是这是看土壤小字描述才知道的，卡面上没有任何提示导致我一开始以为施肥是永久的/持续到当前作物被采完、给土壤浇水即使没有植物也会逐渐变干这点倒是比较容易看出来，但是这显然应该在新手教程里； 2、没有撤销，导致误操作/伏笔很难受； 3、平衡性做得不好，有些作物/稻草人给人感觉纯粹凑数（羁绊）的，作物像是凑羁绊的伤口，弱稻草人像是污染奖励池。尤其是作物，相互之间除了凑羁绊几乎没有任何combo，导致我经常只想抓同种作物、最多凑凑词条，作物之间没有1+1＞2的爽感； 4、流派之间同质化严重，作物基本只是提供一个词条。目前看来只有强化剂+肥料+割草刀养数值（刚开始玩的时候彩椒数值的美）或者蓝莓注射器（高难无限），其他作物说它不好通关吧，其实最主要还是没什么特色，抓起来卡手，也没什么奇效。作物的技能想象力有限，大多数只是成熟时间和价格的区别，导致玩多了像是重复劳动。 希望后续： 1、作物多样化！无论是作物之间的combo也好，作物种植体验的差异化也好， 需要做得更丰富一些，把一些“无趣”的“凑数作物”好好改一改； 2、稻草人多样化/平衡！举例：稻草人A：手牌+1，稻草人B：犁完所有的地之后手牌+1。完爆是很滑稽的设定，幸运值这个属性感觉也不大对劲。稻草人可以考虑既有泛化又有特化，有综合好用的，也可以有和作物强相关的，比如收割概率浇水和短轴作物之间的这种，但是依旧，胡萝卜和土豆这种体验上感觉区别不大。 3、加撤销功能，加强新手引导。

With all the devs taking the cheap route on UI and pixel or video poker graphics (an auto non buy for me), its refreshing to get a well done and well looking rouge game. The user interface is super clean, the coloring is great, and the pictures are grade A. The gameplay is well done too. Many options to go down with the way you want to approach things. Runs are long enough to develop a style but not too long to make the game feel like a drag. Good progression with an easy to understand concept that lets you get as complex as you want to get, that makes a 10/10 rouge game for me. Gameplay looks to be about 20-30 hours IMO. 10/10 especially at the price, well done devs.

The cozy fall art style of this game attracted me, the addicting gameplay hooked me. This is a fun game with a lot of different builds to try. Balance is all over the place in this game, some scarecrows / crops are good then some are game breaking over powered. I enjoyed this game so much, I got all the achievements.

I think the game is very well made, interaction feels good animations are good too. I think it is fun to plan your positioning to maximize the use of water and to grow the crops. I like openning booster packs too. The reason for me to give a negative review is that the game lacks depth. I felt like quickly you just end up doing the same things the same ways. You just plant, water and harvest. I think most of the variation in the cards are just very similar. The scarecrows are nice to guide your build, but in the end I thought it didn't change things that much. As someone that plays a lot of roguelike games, the base game loop got stale fast and I really didn't see many different paths of builds I could take. My advice to the devs is, create new ways to make money. Since making money is what is necessary, maybe add machines that produce grain from plants, or other ways. Something that really make it very different the gameplay experience of going one path or another. Right now I only saw 1 path, harvest more crops at higher quality. I think the game has potential and can be improved.
